{"code": "# Compute conversion rate within each segment for each channel
segment_channel_conv = sales_df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(segment_channel_conv)

# Get overall segment proportions (weights)
overall_segment_prop = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print(f"\nOverall segment proportions:\n{overall_segment_prop}")

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel
weighted_conv_email = (segment_channel_conv.loc['loyal', 'email'] * overall_segment_prop['loyal'] + 
                        segment_channel_conv.loc['new', 'email'] * overall_segment_prop['new'] + 
                        segment_channel_conv.loc['returning', 'email'] * overall_segment_prop['returning'])

weighted_conv_paid_search = (segment_channel_conv.loc['loyal', 'paid_search'] * overall_segment_prop['loyal'] + 
                             segment_channel_conv.loc['new', 'paid_search'] * overall_segment_prop['new'] + 
                             segment_channel_conv.loc['returning', 'paid_search'] * overall_segment_prop['returning'])

# Compute the difference in weighted conversion rates
difference = weighted_conv_email - weighted_conv_paid_search

print(f"\nWeighted conversion rate (email): {weighted_conv_email}")
print(f"\nWeighted conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_conv_paid_search}")
print(f"\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
